title: Head of Enterprise Architecture
description:
The Head of Enterprise Architecture will act as the custodian of technology architecture for Adani Group, holding end\-to\-end accountability for defining, governing and evolving the Group's technology blueprint across its diversified portfolio of independently operating businesses.
 



 As custodian of architecture across the Group, the role holds the mandate to ensure that technology investments made independently by each business remain strategically aligned, secure, scalable, interoperable, cost\-efficient and designed for reuse. The role chairs the Group Architecture Review Board as the Group's principal governance checkpoint for major technology decisions, and is accountable for the disciplined evaluation of new and emerging technologies before they are adopted at scale.
 



 The role will work closely with Group leadership, Business CDOs/CTOs, the Group CISO and Cyber team, and transformation leaders to evolve the organization from application\-centric technology landscapes toward a platform\-, data\- and API\-driven enterprise architecture.
 



 The role partners closely with the Group's AI Labs, Cloud Engineering and Data organization, aligning their platforms and roadmaps to the wider enterprise architecture, while those functions retain ownership of their respective domains.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Act as the Group's custodian of enterprise architecture: own the Group Enterprise Architecture strategy, principles, standards, reference architectures and the 3–5 year technology roadmap, applied consistently across every Adani Group business.
* Chair the Group Architecture Review Board (ARB) — the central governance body for enterprise technology decisions:
* Set the ARB's review criteria, escalation thresholds and decision rights, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards without slowing day\-to\-day business execution.
* Maintain the ARB as the final sign\-off authority for cross\-business platform, cloud, data and cybersecurity architecture decisions.
* Own the evaluation of new and emerging technologies for the Group:
* Maintain an Enterprise Technology Radar and a documented evaluation framework (business fit, security, cost, interoperability, vendor viability) to assess candidate technologies.
* Systematically move promising technologies — spanning cloud, data platforms, cybersecurity, integration, edge and IoT/OT — from evaluation to proof\-of\-concept, production pilot and Group\-wide adoption.
* Act as the final architectural authority on technology and vendor selection decisions referred to the ARB.
* Establish and lead a federated architecture model that provides Group\-level direction while enabling individual businesses — Ports, Airports, Power, Green Energy, Cement, Gas Distribution and Data Centers — to retain appropriate technology autonomy.
* Drive standardization and reuse of platforms, APIs, data products, integration patterns, cloud foundations, identity, observability and common technology services across all Group businesses.
* Establish architecture principles for hybrid cloud, edge computing, high\-performance compute infrastructure, IoT and industrial/OT environments, reflecting the Group's asset\-intensive businesses.
* Drive technology economics and rationalization across the Group, reducing duplicated platforms, unnecessary licenses, technical debt and long\-term total cost of ownership (TCO).
* Build and lead a high\-calibre central Enterprise Architecture team, and develop a federated architecture community of practice across Adani Group businesses.



**Key Success Measures** 




 Success will be measured through Group\-wide business and technology outcomes, including:
 


* Throughput and turnaround time of decisions reviewed by the Architecture Review Board.
* Proportion of new technologies moved from Technology Radar evaluation through PoC to production and Group\-wide scale.
* Increased reuse and reduced duplication of platforms, data products and technical debt across businesses.
* Improved interoperability between business\-unit systems and Group\-level platforms.
* Lower Group\-wide technology TCO and stronger resilience and cybersecurity posture.
* Consistency of security\-by\-design outcomes, validated jointly with the CISO/Cyber team, across ARB decisions.
* Faster, more consistent technology decision\-making across independently operating businesses.



**Candidate Profile** 




 15–20 years of technology experience, with significant leadership responsibility in large and complex enterprises; prior experience chairing or participating in an enterprise architecture review board or equivalent technology governance forum is highly desirable.
 



 Strong experience across enterprise architecture, technology strategy, cloud and infrastructure, enterprise applications/SAP, data platforms, integration, cybersecurity and emerging technology evaluation. Practical understanding of edge computing and modern platform engineering is highly desirable, along with experience partnering with dedicated Cloud Engineering, Data and AI organizations within a large enterprise.
 



 Experience in diversified, infrastructure\-intensive conglomerates spanning sectors such as ports and logistics, energy and utilities, airports, cement and building materials, or data centers would be directly relevant to the scope of this role.
 



 The candidate must combine deep technical credibility, business and commercial understanding, systems thinking, strong executive communication, and the ability to chair cross\-functional governance forums — working closely with Business CDOs/CTOs, the CISO/Cyber team, and specialist AI, Cloud Engineering and Data organizations — to influence technology decisions across independently operating businesses.

description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group** 
 : Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Adani Airports Holding Limited** 
 : Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state\-of\-the\-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world\-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Lead \- Projects IT will be responsible for managing and overseeing the successful installation, testing and commissioning of IT systems and technologies across all construction projects. This includes overseeing IT infrastructure deployments, construction project management systems, and ensuring the integration of advanced technology solutions to support efficient airport construction processes. The role requires collaboration with internal teams, external contractors, and stakeholders to ensure IT systems are aligned with construction objectives, safety regulations, and compliance standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**IT Project Management:**
* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of IT projects focused on construction, such as Building Information Modeling (BIM) integration, project management software (e.g., SAP or Oracle), and real\-time data analytics tools.
* Coordinate the implementation of IT systems for construction project monitoring, scheduling, resource allocation, and cost tracking.
* Develop and manage detailed project plans, ensuring alignment with construction timelines, safety standards, and airport regulations.


**Construction IT Systems**
* Ensure that technology solutions, such as BIM, are effectively integrated with airport construction activities to enhance project collaboration and improve efficiency.
* Oversee the deployment of IT systems that support digital twins, GIS mapping, construction automation tools, data centers, network architecture, communication systems and compliance with aviation and construction standards.
* Manage the installation of network infrastructure, including fiber optics, IoT sensors, and wireless systems to support real\-time project tracking and remote monitoring.
* Collaborate with airport operations to provide operational support for critical 24/7 airport functions related to construction projects.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Collaborate with the construction and IT teams, contractors, suppliers, and regulatory bodies to deliver IT projects that support the airport's construction activities.
* Act as a liaison between the IT department and construction stakeholders to ensure technology meets project requirements and adheres to regulatory compliance.


**Risk Management \& Compliance**
* Identify potential IT risks related to construction projects and develop mitigation strategies.
* Ensure that all IT systems used in construction meet industry standards and aviation regulations (e.g., ICAO, IATA) and comply with cybersecurity and data protection protocols.
* Address health and safety concerns by ensuring that IT systems are designed to support safe construction practices.


**Budget And Financial Oversight**
* Oversee the IT project budget specific to construction, ensuring cost\-effective use of resources and technology investments.
* Provide financial forecasts and reports on project IT expenditures to senior management.


**Vendor And Contract Management**
* Negotiate and manage relationships with IT vendors, ensuring the delivery of quality services and adherence to contractual obligations.
* Oversee the procurement of IT systems and services, ensuring alignment with the airport's long\-term technology roadmap.


**Digital Mindset**
* Drive the adoption of innovative digital technologies like BIM, IoT, and data analytics to enhance efficiency in construction projects.
* Stay updated with emerging construction technologies to improve efficiency and ensure airport infrastructure is built using advanced IT solutions.


**Team Leadership And Development**
* Lead and mentor team members by providing constructive feedback, helping them develop their technical and project management skills.
* Develop a pipeline of talent within the team to ensure continuity in IT projects.
* Actively engage the team by promoting a positive work culture and recognizing individual and collective achievements.


**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
* Head \- Construction
* Project Head
* IT Department Head
* Project Management Team
* IT Infrastructure Team
* Construction Engineers
* Techno Commercial \& Contracts Department
* Compliance \& Regulatory Department
* Finance and Budgeting Team


**Key Stakeholders \- External**
* Civil Aviation Authority
* Technology Vendors and Service Providers
* External Contractors and Subcontractors
* Government Regulatory Bodies
* IT Consultants
* Health and Safety Agencies
* External Auditors and Inspectors
* BCAS/DGCA


**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology/Electronics/Instrumentation or a related field.
* A Master’s degree in IT or Project Management, or relevant certifications (PMP, PRINCE2\) is preferred.


**Work Experience**
* 12\+ years of experience in IT project management, with specific experience in managing IT systems for large\-scale infrastructure or construction projects with minimum 5 years experience in airports.

title: Senior Golang Engineer - Observability Preferred
description:
**Role \- Senior Golang Engineer \- Observability Preferred** 




**Experience: 3\+ Years** 




**Location: Ahmedabad** 




  





**Position Overview:** 




  





 We are looking for a systems\-minded developer with 3–5 years of hands\-on experience who is comfortable
 



 working close to the machine in Go/Rust, and equally comfortable reasoning about distributed behavior
 



 across a cloud\-native deployment. The ideal candidate has worked in the observability domain — metrics,
 



 logs, traces, time\-series storage and enjoys owning a module end to end. This is a high\-ownership role in a
 



 small, fast\-moving team. You will work across multiple modules, make design calls, use AI\-assisted
 



 development as a daily tool, and be accountable for what you ship in production.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibility:** 




  





**•** 
 Build and scale services for operational data ingestion, enrichment, storage, and query in a
 



 multitenant SaaS environment — spanning push\-based telemetry (metrics, logs, traces), polland protocol\-based collection (SNMP, WMI, SSH, ICMP), event streams (traps, syslog, flow), and
 



 discovery and inventory data.
 



 • Work with event/message\-driven pipelines (NATS) and time\-series, relational, and cache
 



 stores.
 



 • Design ingestion paths that handle heterogeneous sources and cadences — high\-volume
 



 streaming, scheduled polling cycles, bursty event traffic, and transactional API writes — each
 



 with different latency, ordering, and backpressure characteristics.
 



 • Normalize collected data into a common internal model, applying OpenTelemetry semantic
 



 conventions where they fit and defining consistent conventions where they don't, so
 



 downstream consumers see one shape regardless of source.
 



 • Build the data substrate for anomaly and signal detection — streaming aggregation, rollingwindow state, baselining, and correlation across metrics, logs, and traces — and integrate
 



 model inference into the ingestion and query path within latency and resource budgets.
 



 Own system design for your modules — write and defend design notes covering data
 



 model, interfaces, scaling limits, failure modes, and rollback.
 



 • Debug production problems end to end — reproduce, isolate, instrument, and fix issues
 



 including performance regressions and platform\-specific behavior.
 



 • Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as part of the normal development loop,
 



 while retaining full ownership of correctness, security, and design quality of the generated
 



 output.
 



 • Write clean, testable, well\-instrumented code, participate in code reviews, and contribute
 



 to design and engineering documentation.
 



 • Collaborate with product managers, and fellow engineers to deliver high\-quality features.
 



 • Continuously learn and apply modern development practices and tools.
 



  





**Skills and Qualifications:** 




  





**•** 
 B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT
 



 • Minimum 3 years of hands\-on backend engineering, with production\-level proficiency in Go and the
 



 ability and appetite to work in Rust.
 



 • Demonstrable experience in the observability domain: metrics, logs, traces, agents, collectors,
 



 monitoring systems, or telemetry pipelines.
 



 • Working knowledge of cloud and distributed systems — containers, Kubernetes, service\-to\-service
 



 communication, and the standard distributed failure modes (partial failure, backpressure, retries,
 



 idempotency).
 



 • Strong debugging and production problem\-solving ability using profilers, tracing, logs, and metrics.
 



 • Experience with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus or similar observability infrastructure.
 



 • Strong reasoning and first\-principles problem\-solving — the ability to break down an unfamiliar
 



 problem, form a hypothesis, and test it, rather than pattern\-matching to a previous solution.
 



 • Adaptive mindset — comfortable with changing priorities, evolving requirements, and switching
 



 between languages, platforms, and modules.
 



 • AI\-ready working style — treats AI tooling as leverage, prompts and reviews critically, and
 



 understands where generated code needs to be challenged.
 



 • A strong reading and self\-learning habit — follows source code, specifications, and engineering
 



 blogs, and can bring what they read back into the product.
 



 • Working comfort with statistical concepts as applied to time\-series (distributions, seasonality,
 



 percentiles, drift) and the ability to implement a detection algorithm from a specification or paper.
 



 • Ownership and accountability — takes a module from design through production support, raises
 



 risks early, and does not treat a handoff as the end of responsibility

title: Senior Cloud Engineer/Lead – Multi-Cloud Platform
description:
**Position**
 Senior Cloud Engineer/Lead – Multi\-Cloud Platform
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Engineer to join our Cloud Platform Engineering team responsible for building, securing, automating, and operating a modern multi\-cloud platform. The successful candidate will play a key role in designing and managing enterprise\-scale cloud infrastructure across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), while driving automation, security, reliability, scalability, and platform standardization.
   

  

 Shift Timing
   

  

 5:00 PM to 1:00 AM IST
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, implement, operate, and troubleshoot secure, highly available cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and OCI.
* Manage cloud networking, VPC/VCN design, DNS, routing, load balancing, IAM, and cloud governance services.
* Support production environments through incident response, root cause analysis, remediation, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Establish multi\-cloud architecture standards, best practices, operational procedures, and reusable platform components.
* Collaborate with Platform Engineering, SRE, DevOps, Security, and Application Engineering teams.


**Cloud Automation \& Infrastructure as Code**
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform and CloudFormation.
* Develop reusable Terraform modules and self\-service infrastructure frameworks.
* Automate provisioning, configuration management, compliance, patching, access management, and operational workflows.
* Create automation solutions using Python, Bash, and PowerShell scripts.


**Identity \& Access Management**
* Implement and support enterprise IAM solutions using Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Okta, Ping Identity, PingFederate, AWS IAM, and IAM Identity Center.
* Configure and troubleshoot complex SSO, Federation, SAML, OAuth, OIDC, MFA, authentication, authorization, and user provisioning.
* Implement least\-privilege access controls and support governance, reviews, and compliance requirements.


**Systems Administration \& Security**
* Administer Linux and Windows Server environments including hardening, patching, monitoring, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
* Support cloud security initiatives including secrets management, certificates, encryption, TLS/SSL, and vulnerability remediation.
* Perform security assessments and partner with security teams to reduce infrastructure and IAM risk.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 10\+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure, Systems Engineering, DevOps, or Platform Engineering.
* 3\+ years of technical leadership or people leadership experience.
* Strong production experience with at least two major cloud platforms and preferably all three AWS, GCP, and OCI.
* Expertise in Terraform and Infrastructure as Code methodologies.
* Strong Linux and Windows administration experience.
* Deep understanding of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Routing, Firewalls, Load Balancing, Proxies, and TLS/SSL.
* Experience with enterprise IAM and modern authentication technologies.
* Strong scripting and automation experience using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
* Experience with CI/CD, DevOps practices, cloud security, and complex production troubleshooting.


**Technical Skills**
* Cloud Platforms: AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Terraform Modules
* AWS Services: EKS, VPC, S3, IAM, IAM Identity Center, Route53, CloudFront, Lambda, CloudWatch, Organizations
* GCP Services: GKE, VPC, IAM, Cloud DNS
* OCI Services: OKE, VCN, IAM
* IAM \& Authentication: Entra ID, Active Directory, Okta, Ping Identity, SAML, OAuth, OIDC, SSO, Federation, MFA
* Containers: Docker, Kubernetes, EKS, GKE, OKE
* Automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell
* Observability: Datadog, CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana
* Configuration Management: Ansible
* Security: IAM, Secrets Management, Certificates, Encryption, Cloud Security
* Networking: DNS, Routing, VPN, Firewalls, Proxies, Load Balancing, TCP/IP, TLS/SSL


**Preferred Qualifications**
* AWS Solutions Architect, AWS SysOps, AWS Security Specialty, GCP, or OCI certifications.
* Experience with Kubernetes platforms and enterprise cloud landing zones.
* Experience with AWS Control Tower, Organizations, SCPs, and governance frameworks.
* Experience with GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Harness, and modern CI/CD platforms.
* Experience working in large\-scale enterprise and multi\-account multi\-cloud environments.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Build reliable, secure, and automated multi\-cloud platforms at scale.
* Reduce operational effort through automation and standardization.
* Improve infrastructure self\-service capabilities for engineering teams.
* Enhance cloud security, governance, IAM controls, and platform consistency.
* Act as a technical mentor and subject matter expert for cloud and platform engineering initiatives.


**Why Join The Team**
* Work on a modern cloud platform supporting global products and services.
* Drive strategic infrastructure modernization and automation initiatives.
* Influence enterprise networking standards, governance, and architecture.
* Work alongside Cloud, Security, SRE, Infrastructure, and Platform Engineering experts.


**Location:**
 IN\-GJ\-Ahmedabad, India\-Ognaj (eInfochips)
   

  

**Time Type**
 Full time
   

  

**Job Category**
 Engineering Services
